data.raw_text:
After a deep scrape of every #DFC #BoardofDirectors agenda from 2020 to today, $GLO is an outlier:

- 28 meetings identified
- 108 projects listed for approval (3,86 projects per meeting)
- only 6 (?) publicly listed counterparties across the full sample

-> None clearly tied to major Western exchanges in the usual sense (North America / Western Europe), with listings instead appearing in markets such as Istanbul, Palestine, the Philippines, etc.

Against that backdrop, #GlobalAtomic appears to be a near outlier: a company publicly traded on Western markets (#Canada/#Europe), also accessible to U.S. investors, reaching the DFC approval pipeline.
A second point is just as notable: almost every meeting includes a project-approval list, except June 2025 (1 out of 28). 

The last 20th February 2026 meeting is associated with a specific Sunshine Act exemption, which reasonably raises additional questions and warrants closer scrutiny.
If all goes well, I’ll publish a full breakdown with data, sources, and methodology.

#uranium #U308 #nuclear #dasa $GLO #GLO #Niger
